patterns: APPSC asks activity-to-sector one-liners: transport = tertiary (APPSC GS 2018); mining classification is a known trap.
Other PSCs ask type terms: genetic industry = agriculture, stock farming = breeding of animals.
Collar colours and Fisher-Clark are likely single-fact or pair-match items.
App leans on 2025-26 data (new GDP base, AP GVA shares, IIP revision) in multi-statement form; PYQs are conceptual one-liners.
